'''Yosh Woon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] raid leader for the [[Tonvarr pirates]] who was stationed to guard [[Fort Tonvarr]] alongside [[Elu Neleh]] and [[Gredan Obsnog]]. Eventually he was killed alongside other Tonvarr pirates.<ref name="Encounter">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|The Fall of Fort Tonvarr|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref>
